BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Jade Raptor!!
Hey, she's in danger, isn't she?\nLooks like magic attacks don't work on it.
Thanks.\nI was using magic for a long time...\nI was almost at my limit, thanks...
Me?\nI'm Saria. I'm fiddling with magic around here.\nNice to meet ya.
Are you the one that Tolan was talkin' about?\nWe were asked to help you defeat monsters...
Tolan? So, he's alright... Great.\nActually, many monsters that are immune to Diel's\nmagic appeared recently and we're in trouble...
A Diel caravan is supposed to arrive here\nsoon, but...
There's nothing we can do if we encounter the\nmonsters like before.\nSo, we're at a loss what to do...
I haven't really heard of the Diel caravan.\nIs it something like the Straye merchant caravan?
No no.\nIt's more like a nomadic caravan, traveling and\ngathering Diels.
No mad??
After the Cataclysm, the Diels except those who\nbecame Straye built small villages or city-states\nhere and there.
But it's getting too hard for us to prevent\nthe endless string of unusual phenomenons and\nmonster invasions from happening...
We know. We saw it with our own eyes...\nA city like Sofya has many people that can protect\nthe city but...
A small town in a remote area can be destroyed\neven by just one monster...
...One day, someone suggested the Diels to gather\nin one place and rebuild the former Diel's country\ncalled Mithurna. That's why we're traveling now.
Tolan and I are in charge of guiding the Diel\ncaravans coming from other places to the land\nwhere our leader's waiting...
...Hm, I guess I can count on you.\nIf the Diel caravan that comes here is\nattacked by monsters,
Please help them by defeating the monsters!\nI beg of you!
Stoooop!\nWe are not traveling for charity work.
We had a hard time scrounging up the travel\nexpenses.\nWe need some decent rewards.
I understood. Hmm...\nOh, yes. The Diel caravans have a lot of money\nas their travel funds.
Why don't you ask them for it?\nThey won't say no because you protect them from\nthe monsters, right?
Really?!\nThat's a deal.
No time to waste! Hurry!
Hey! What are you doin'?!\nI've never seen an Elf attacking the weak!
?! Don't come here! Run!!
Hyaah?!
Whoa?! What's that?!\nIsn't it an Elf wizard?!
G... Gwaaaahhhh!!
W-What was that...
Thank you for saving us.\nWe all would have been destroyed without your\nhelp...
Oh, sorry.\nI'm the leader of this caravan. Rolca.\nNice to meet you...
Hmm, this is terrible but...\nFortunately, nobody is injured.
Well, now we can join the other Diels.\nWe can never thank you enough.
Heh heh, we just couldn't pretend not to see you.\nDon't mention it.
But if you have something like a token of\ngratitude, we are ready to accept it.
Um, ah... You know.\nWe have used almost all of the money to travel\nhere.
I really hate to say this but...\nThere's nothing we can give you.\nWe're so sorry...
N-Not again...
Please don't feel down.\nYou may not like it but I can tell you a rumor\nabout treasure...
I heard there was an uncharted town ahead of this\nterrace. The rumor says there's a great treasure\nin the town.
We were going to find it before we join the other\ncaravans but we'll leave it to you.\nWhy don't you go there?
I-I'm back on my feet again!! The treasure must be\nthere...Hey! What are you doing?\nWe can't let our efforts go to waste! Hurry up!
I heard the entrance's to the east of the terrace.\nWatch your steps!

Hey, Balft.\nWhat are you doing at this kind of place?
Oh, it's you guys...
The truth is I heard there's someone with bombs\nor poison around here. I've been on the watch,\nbut I haven't seen anyone suspicious...bleh
Now you have terrible dark circles under your\neyes! Since when have you been here?
Since about 3 days ago...There's no guarantee that\nhe or she won't pass at night, so I haven't been\nsleeping. But no one's been suspicious so far.
Either bombs or hazardous substances, it should be\nquite noticeable when someone carry them, right?
Oh?! Oh, waaiiit!!
So, it's you!!!
Wait whaat?! W-wait a sec!!
No more excuse! Grrrrr!!
Oh noo!! That terrifying look in his eyes.\nHey, adventurer! Do something!!
Balft, you're awake?
Oh gosh!!
Balft, stop it!!
Oh no...
The box was broken and all the chocolates inside\nspilt out...
Balft!!
Uh? What did I...Oh, it must have been because of\nmy lack of sleep...
Oh, oh my, Triel, what's wrong?
What do you mean by what's wrong?!\nBeing half asleep and destroying their belongings?\nWhat are you going to do now?!
O-oh!! Who did such a horrible thing...
You! It was you!!
I'm so sorry!! As you can see, I lost my cool\nbecause I haven't had enough sleep, and I didn't\nknow it was something entrusted to you...
You don't have to apologize so much.\nI know you didn't mean it and you're just being\ntoo hard on yourself...
Since the box is broken, we can't just take it to\nSofya like that. Shall we go back to Filecia's?
Please tell the person who entrusted this box to\nyou that we're really sorry and we'll pay for\nthe damage if necessary when we go to El Scaro...
